versions.changelog:
Version 2.0.1 (ai-company-cfo-2-0-0)

- Updated SKILL.md to reflect a new version (2.4.0), with major content and structure enhancements.
- Introduced three-tier "熔断机制" (circuit breaker) aligning CFO actions with CRO/CISO, reducing decision conflict.
- Added FAIR risk mapping to standard financial metrics, streamlining communication between CFO and CRO.
- Defined monthly milestones and automatic cash flow tracking for better progress monitoring and anomaly detection.
- Enhanced documentation with detailed tables, escalation rules, and compliance routing instructions.

Version 2.0.0

- Major refactor of the skill structure.
- Introduced five core modules for CFO operations.
- Added parameterized circuit breaker (熔断机制) functionality for automated financial risk control.
